_notes: shots play back to back; t = seconds in the film; source used = t*speed; ss = source in-point; images (.png/.jpg) are held for t. sound = dB gain for the shot's own audio (the app's sound from record.mjs); omit it to keep the shot silent; keep speed 1 on shots with sound. voice 'at' = film seconds. Everything runs at 25 fps: the screen recorder and render-frames.mjs both make 25 fps, never convert to 30.
